evaluator: Codex assistant (semantic evaluation subagent; not an independent student review)
method: Offline manual reading of every unedited answer against the frozen six-question key and actual prompt/context/citation mapping. All 22 prompts and context hit records were checked byte-for-byte equal to the previously fully read run 02; every new answer was independently read. No evaluator model calls. Distinct factual propositions are counted once; restated questions and repeated wording are not added to the denominator. Epistemic inability-to-answer statements and clarification requests are nonanswers, but independent assertions about document topics, procedures, source attribution, or deadlines count. Partial support does not credit a whole proposition. True full-corpus facts are not counted faithful unless the actual supplied chunks support their standalone meaning. A has N/A context faithfulness. Citation syntax is separate from citation-supported grounding; omission of an essential fact makes accuracy false even if emitted claims are otherwise correct. Exact refusal format is separate from whether abstention was appropriate; Q4 requires clarification. Citation-only output is a nonanswer, not a grounded answer. Raw and final evidence coverage were recomputed from frozen source offsets with evidence_span_coverage. Historical document evaluation is not current legal advice.
